text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the inside of the circle of Adra Grado Way and Okra Tomar Crescent be amended to a stopping prohibition. The proposed amendment will further deter parking / standing / stopping, which obstructs two-way traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Referred the item back to the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, until all reports for parking amendments on Adra Grado Way have been submitted to North York Community Council, and requested the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, to report on Adra Grado Way and Okra Tomar Crescent Parking Amendments at that time.
